_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: receipt_search_index
data.create_virtual_stmt: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "receipt_search_index" USING fts5(receipt_identifier UNINDEXED, receipt_line_identifier UNINDEXED, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')

sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_search_index" USING fts5(receipt_identifier UNINDEXED, receipt_line_identifier UNINDEXED, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preference_entries" ("preference_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "encoded_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("preference_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_metadata" ("singleton_identifier" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_migrated_by_application_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "migrated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "storage_places" ("storage_place_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "storage_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("storage_place_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compartments" ("compartment_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_place_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES storage_places (storage_place_identifier), "default_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "color_tag_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("compartment_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("category_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "recommended_maximum_storage_days" INTEGER NULL, "shelf_life_after_opening_days" INTEGER NULL, "icon_emoji" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "storage_domain" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'freezer', PRIMARY KEY ("category_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("product_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (category_identifier), "catalog_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "canonical_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_package_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "recommended_maximum_storage_days" INTEGER NULL, "shelf_life_after_opening_days" INTEGER NULL, "icon_emoji" TEXT NULL, "icon_image" BLOB NULL, "default_compartment_identifier" TEXT NULL REFERENCES compartments (compartment_identifier), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "piece_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_batches" ("stock_batch_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "compartment_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES compartments (compartment_identifier), "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity_remaining" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_batch_identifier" TEXT NULL, "stored_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "best_before_on" TEXT NULL, "opened_on" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("stock_batch_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_movements" ("movement_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_batch_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_batches (stock_batch_identifier), "product_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "compartment_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES compartments (compartment_identifier), "movement_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discard_reason" TEXT NULL, "reverses_movement_identifier" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("movement_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_notification_records" ("notification_identifier" INTEGER NOT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_for" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("notification_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "restock_rules" ("product_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "quantity_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "minimum_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_entries" ("shopping_list_entry_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_identifier" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "free_text_name" TEXT NULL, "quantity_unit" TEXT NULL, "requested_quantity" INTEGER NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "checked_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("shopping_list_entry_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_pictures" ("item_picture_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "encrypted_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumbnail_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "width_pixels" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height_pixels" INTEGER NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_picture_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_barcodes" ("barcode_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "symbology" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_variable_measure" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_variable_measure" IN (0, 1)), "learned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("barcode_value"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipts" ("receipt_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "store_name" TEXT NULL, "purchased_on" TEXT NULL, "total_in_cents" INTEGER NULL, "page_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recognized_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_pages" ("receipt_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts (receipt_identifier), "page_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "picture_reference" TEXT NULL, "raw_recognized_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_identifier", "page_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_lines" ("receipt_line_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts (receipt_identifier), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "recognized_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "corrected_text" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_in_cents" INTEGER NULL, "line_total_in_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_in_grams" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_identifier" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "stock_batch_identifier" TEXT NULL REFERENCES stock_batches (stock_batch_identifier), PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_line_identifier"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_text_mappings" ("store_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_identifier" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (product_identifier), "learned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("store_name", "line_text"));
CREATE INDEX inventory_movements_by_time ON inventory_movements (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX inventory_movements_by_product_and_time ON inventory_movements (product_identifier, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX inventory_movements_by_batch ON inventory_movements (stock_batch_identifier)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX item_pictures_by_owner ON item_pictures (owner_kind, owner_identifier)
CREATE INDEX product_barcodes_by_product ON product_barcodes (product_identifier)
CREATE INDEX receipts_by_creation ON receipts (created_at)
CREATE INDEX receipt_lines_by_receipt ON receipt_lines (receipt_identifier, position)
